name: hbm_svc_SE_s0_rob_2ac2226ca_tc_hm10_pdn-cl
purpose: tputx-svc SVC.STREAM throughput restructure (results/rtl/tput_map_1011/svc_stream): hfd_svc_SE_s0 with the per-PC READ REORDER BUFFER (one ot_sram_1r1w_128x256 macro per PC unit, fixed by split_psfc/<m>/rob_place.tcl), KNO 31 outstanding, drain-side credits, two descriptor slots (overlap) and the 2-b done count chain.
